###    🚀 Features

- **cache**: Add fs module cache env variables  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11859 [<samp>(708c0)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/708c05da0)

###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- Rerun on file changes after a config restart  -  by @magurotuna in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11772 and https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11829 [<samp>(289ca)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/289caab9c)
- Avoid leaking the context expect  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11845 [<samp>(3c967)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/3c967a7b7)
- Report fixture teardown errors once  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11857 [<samp>(6b167)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/6b167eb79)
- Improve diffs for asymmetric matchers  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11855 [<samp>(86775)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/86775420f)
- Apply --shard before the test run starts  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11846 [<samp>(e5c80)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/e5c80b775)
- Reset local expect state between retries for `expect.assertions/hasAssertions`  -  by @hi-ogawa and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11900 [<samp>(50dcd)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/50dcdb373)
- Sort test files before the seeded shuffle  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11926 [<samp>(3aa30)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/3aa3045a9)
- Tear down fixture contexts one at a time  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11956 [<samp>(5712b)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/5712b5fd2)
- Count merged errors in the error divider  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11955 [<samp>(4bc4f)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/4bc4f86e8)
- Match `-` and `.` in `noExternal` wildcards  -  by @hi-ogawa and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11978 [<samp>(efba8)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/efba8cbfe)
- Give each test attempt a new `signal`  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11998 [<samp>(77a30)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/77a306757)
- Throw timeout error classes instead of Error  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/12003 [<samp>(9b874)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/9b87492f7)
- **ast-collect**:
  - Only collect calls with a name argument  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11853 [<samp>(c015a)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/c015ad5a6)
- **browser**:
  - Scale the iframe for preview without the UI  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11856 [<samp>(034d4)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/034d44e54)
  - Fix expect.element with `message` and remove redundant `[ERROR]` in trace steps  -  by @hi-ogawa and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11832 [<samp>(1d115)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/1d115dcc3)
- **cache**:
  - Always leave a manifest to the fs module cache  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11858 [<samp>(1b238)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/1b2380c88)
  - Watch cached files outside the root  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11860 [<samp>(9c044)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/9c044db81)

detail.readme:
Vitest

Next generation testing framework powered by Vite.

Get involved!

Documentation | Getting Started | Examples | Why Vitest?

中文文档



## Features - [Vite](https://vitejs.dev/)'s config, transformers, resolvers, and plugins. Use the same setup from your app! - [Jest Snapshot](https://jestjs.io/docs/snapshot-testing) - [Chai](https://www.chaijs.com/) built-in for assertions, with [Jest expect](https://jestjs.io/docs/expect) compatible APIs - [Smart & instant watch mode](https://vitest.dev/guide/features.html#watch-mode), like HMR for tests! - [Native code coverage](https://vitest.dev/guide/features.html#coverage) via [`v8`](https://v8.dev/blog/javascript-code-coverage) or [`istanbul`](https://istanbul.js.org/). - Jest-compatible mocking, stubbing, and spies. - [JSDOM](https://github.com/jsdom/jsdom) and [happy-dom](https://github.com/capricorn86/happy-dom) for DOM and browser API mocking - [Browser Mode](https://vitest.dev/guide/browser/) for running component tests in the browser - Components testing ([Vue](https://github.com/vitest-tests/browser-examples/tree/main/examples/vue), [React](https://github.com/vitest-tests/browser-examples/tree/main/examples/react), [Svelte](https://github.com/vitest-tests/browser-examples/tree/main/examples/svelte), [Lit](./examples/lit), [Marko](https://github.com/marko-js/examples/tree/master/examples/library-ts)) - Benchmarking support with [Tinybench](https://github.com/tinylibs/tinybench) - [Projects](https://vitest.dev/guide/projects) support - [expect-type](https://github.com/mmkal/expect-type) for type-level testing - ESM first, top level await - Out-of-box TypeScript / JSX support - Filtering, timeouts, concurrent for suite and tests - Sharding support - Reporting Uncaught Errors - Run your tests in the browser natively > Vitest requires Vite >=v6.4.0 and Node >=v22.12.0 ```ts import { assert, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest' describe('suite name', () => { it('foo', () => { expect(1 + 1).toEqual(2) expect(true).to.be.true }) it('bar', () => { assert.equal(Math.sqrt(4), 2) }) it('snapshot', () => { expect({ foo: 'bar' }).toMatchSnapshot() }) }) ``` ```bash $ npx vitest ``` ## Sponsors

## Credits Thanks to: - [The Jest team and community](https://jestjs.io/) for creating a delightful testing API - [@lukeed](https://github.com/lukeed) for the work on [uvu](https://github.com/lukeed/uvu) where we are inspired a lot from. - [@pi0](https://github.com/pi0) for the idea and implementation of using Vite to transform and bundle the server code. - [The Vite team](https://github.com/vitejs/vite) for brainstorming the initial idea. - [@patak-dev](https://github.com/patak-dev) for the awesome package name! ## Contribution See [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). ## License [MIT](./LICENSE) License © 2021-Present VoidZero Inc. and Vitest contributors
